items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: the original Onward brass band was, uh, Manny Perez and, uh, Joe Oliver... I had, uh, the Rensitio clarinet

ctx.x: You told me once he played alto on the one. Yeah, that's right. The piano player.
The Onward. You see, the Onward, the original Onward brass band was, uh, Manny Perez and, uh, Joe Oliver, wasn't it?
